config.source: value versus weighted, alternating colors; 400 turns / 8000 actions
config.sampling: uniform reservoir per phase, non-forced decisions, no prompt truncation
config.teacher: 2 determinized dev-card worlds x 100 MCTS simulations; random rollouts; horizon 120
config.teacher_limit: Resource hands remain privileged; only hidden dev cards and deck are resampled.
config.coverage: Every legal action visited in both worlds; menus above 100 actions excluded from dataset
config.reward: 2 * pooled root mean value - 1; invalid output -2
config.agreement: any maximum-value action within 1e-8; invalid disagrees; forced excluded
config.sft_target: smallest ID among tied maximum-value actions
config.checkpoint: last completed round; no selection on dev/test
config.control: SFT from same initial weights, same sampled prompts and update count; lower token compute
config.game_decode: greedy; invalid/overlength prompt uses seeded uniform legal fallback, logged
config.success: test agreement gain >= .10 and observed actual win rate >= untuned; all evaluations complete
config.interval: paired cluster bootstrap of differences, 10000 resamples seed 611; game/board is cluster
config.budget_stop: finish current training round or evaluation board pair; incomplete evaluation is inconclusive

public_bundle.selection: First paired board; all other episodes retain outcome and action summaries. Model weights are not bundled.
